test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Her comfort was in her children; / her second son, Rupert, / was especially dear to her.

options.text: Her comfort was in her children

solution:
The correct answer is **No error.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• There is no error in the given sentence.
 
• Thus the correct option would be no error.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the given sentence object and passive forms have been used.
 
 
• **Her **comfort was in **her** children; / **her** second son, Rupert, / was especially dear to **her**.​
